works.condition_or_failure: 同任务内自改与跨任务继承是不同证据，不能从 solve rate 推出代际增长。
works.separating_intervention: 分别允许任务内修改和跨任务继承并计入所有调用。
works.review_scope: Primary abstract and submission history screened; full methods, costs and robustness not yet reviewed.
works.status: conditional interpretation; no independent reproduction claimed

works.name: Group-Evolving Agents: Open-Ended Self-Improvement via Experience Sharing
works.mechanism_interpretation: 智能体群共享不同进化分支的经验来指导后续结构修改。
works.condition_or_failure: 同进化个体数不保证同算力；探索多样性的价值需与开销分开。
works.separating_intervention: 固定总资源，切断分支间经验共享而保留种群。
works.review_scope: Primary abstract and submission history screened; full methods, costs and robustness not yet reviewed.
works.status: conditional interpretation; no independent reproduction claimed

works.name: Adaptive Auto-Harness: Sustained Self-Improvement for Agentic System Deployment on Open-Ended Task Streams
works.mechanism_interpretation: 任务流驱动持续构建不同 harness，并按任务路由及保留演化经验。
works.condition_or_failure: 部分信号来自人类引导；路由收益不等于改进器变强。
works.separating_intervention: 分别固定构建、路由和人类引导，记录时间向前评估。
works.review_scope: Primary abstract and submission history screened; full methods, costs and robustness not yet reviewed.
works.status: conditional interpretation; no independent reproduction claimed

works.name: Continual Harness: Online Adaptation for Self-Improving Foundation Agents
works.mechanism_interpretation: 代理在持续交互中交替行动并修订持久技能、提示和记忆。
works.condition_or_failure: 早期 GPP 人类参与与后续自动循环必须分开，游戏进度不直接代表通用研发能力。
works.separating_intervention: 冻结自修订但保留同一交互历史和资源上限。
works.review_scope: Primary abstract and submission history screened; full methods, costs and robustness not yet reviewed.
works.status: conditional interpretation; no independent reproduction claimed

works.name: EnvHarness: Awakening Static Worlds for Agent Learning
works.mechanism_interpretation: 根据代理失败生成环境包装组件，保留原验证器并训练策略。
works.condition_or_failure: 环境包装保留验证器是特定设计，不保证所有新任务忠实有效。
works.separating_intervention: 冻结环境生成器、交叉环境和策略版本并评估原任务。
works.review_scope: Primary abstract and submission history screened; full methods, costs and robustness not yet reviewed.
works.status: conditional interpretation; no independent reproduction claimed

works.name: Agentic Discovery of Neural Architectures: AIRA-Compose and AIRA-Design
works.mechanism_interpretation: 研究代理设计计算原语和架构，并将候选扩展到较大模型训练。
works.condition_or_failure: 发现目标模型架构不等于将目标用作下一代设计者。
works.separating_intervention: 把新旧目标作为研究代理，检验后续架构发现能力。
works.review_scope: Primary abstract and submission history screened; full methods, costs and robustness not yet reviewed.
works.status: conditional interpretation; no independent reproduction claimed

works.name: AI4AI-Bench: Benchmarking LLM Agents in Algorithmic Design for Recursive Self-Improvement
works.mechanism_interpretation: 隔离训练算法修改，用隐藏评估器重训提交代码。
works.condition_or_failure: 它测研发能力而非运行多代 RSI，归一化分数仍依赖所选任务和参照。
works.separating_intervention: 比较算法更改与仅运行/超参优化，控制探索和重训预算。
works.review_scope: Primary abstract and submission history screened; full methods, costs and robustness not yet reviewed.
works.status: conditional interpretation; no independent reproduction claimed

works.name: Generalized Agent Iteration: One Formal Framework for Iterative Policy Improvement and Recursive Self-Improvement
works.mechanism_interpretation: 统一描述策略、评价、修改机制及评价基准是否属于可修改系统。
works.condition_or_failure: 属于可重写组件不等于实际发生有效重写；表示统一不是经验泛化定律。
works.separating_intervention: 保持可编辑接口相同，只改变实际修改与后续复用。
works.review_scope: Sections 3.1–3.2: formal components, modifier membership and externally grounded evaluation base.
works.status: conditional interpretation; no independent reproduction claimed

works.name: Aspire: Can Models Self-Evolve from Vague Goals?
works.mechanism_interpretation: 让代理从模糊目标自行选数据和更新方式，再用隐藏专家任务评价。
works.condition_or_failure: 完成训练或编辑流程不等于提高能力；报告中增益稀疏且不稳定。
works.separating_intervention: 比较自定验证与外部目标的一致性，以及继续训练造成的退化。
works.review_scope: Primary abstract and submission history screened; full methods, costs and robustness not yet reviewed.
works.status: conditional interpretation; no independent reproduction claimed

works.name: Large Language Model Agents Are Not Always Faithful Self-Evolvers
works.mechanism_interpretation: 干预原始和压缩经验，检查代理决策是否真正依赖积累经验。
works.condition_or_failure: 对经验不敏感可来自已有知识或压缩丢失，不能一概判为无学习。
works.separating_intervention: 置换/删除经验并跨模型、环境比较行为变化。
works.review_scope: Primary abstract and submission history screened; full methods, costs and robustness not yet reviewed.
works.status: conditional interpretation; no independent reproduction claimed

works.name: ShinkaEvolve: Towards Open-Ended And Sample-Efficient Program Evolution
works.mechanism_interpretation: 通过多样性、父代选择与模型组合提高程序演化样本效率。
works.condition_or_failure: 只有目标涉及 AI 训练/harness 时属直接 AI4AI；普通圆堆积不算自身进化。
works.separating_intervention: 分离目标程序收益和搜索器继承收益并计入所有候选。

works.name: CoVerRL: Breaking the Consensus Trap in Label-Free Reasoning via Generator-Verifier Co-Evolution
works.mechanism_interpretation: 同一模型交替学习生成与验证，以验证反馈过滤自一致错误。
works.condition_or_failure: 多数投票仍提供噪声标签，摆脱部分共识错误不保证无锚点真理发现。
works.separating_intervention: 固定验证器并比较独立标签校准及生成多样性。

works.name: Actor-Curator: Co-adaptive Curriculum Learning via Policy-Improvement Bandits for RL Post-Training
works.mechanism_interpretation: 神经课程选择器直接学习预计策略提升，适配非平稳题库采样。
works.condition_or_failure: 课程控制器的学习不同于其自身更新算法被改进。
works.separating_intervention: 在相同题库/算力下冻结课程，并检验未见任务难度迁移。

works.name: Agent-World: Scaling Real-World Environment Synthesis for Evolving General Agent Intelligence
works.mechanism_interpretation: 探索真实工具生态并生成可验证任务，按能力缺口持续训练。
works.condition_or_failure: MCP 环境主题多不等于未见世界泛化，生成器和验证器来源需全文核查。
works.separating_intervention: 冻结环境库或能力缺口反馈，比较同预算迁移。

works.name: SkillOS: Learning Skill Curation for Self-Evolving Agents
works.mechanism_interpretation: 用较晚关联任务的表现训练技能整理者，执行者保持冻结。
works.condition_or_failure: 改善技能整理者是有价值的 AI4AI，但其更新流程未被自身改写。
works.separating_intervention: 共同目标下交叉整理者版本与执行者底座。
